user_statement: 用户在本轮 S05 硬件采集结束后（2026-11-02，Asia/Shanghai）于实物板上确认：PL_LED1（P15，低电平点亮）保持点亮；PL_LED2（U12，心跳灯）持续闪烁。
observation_method: User visual observation of the physical Z7-LITE_ES1 board in the active session; not inferred from VIO, LTX or simulation.
success_LED_meaning: PL_LED1 is driven by the accepted success output; it was observed lit after three VIO auxiliary resets, consistent with 12/12 CRC cases matching.
heartbeat_LED_meaning: PL_LED2 is driven by the accepted heartbeat output; continuous blinking was observed, not a static level.
user_confirmation_channel: AskUserQuestion answers: success=已点亮, heartbeat=持续闪烁
